reasons.aimed_at_specific_person: The comment addresses one reply target directly ('People like you... Nobody wants you here'), so it is targeted hostility, not general criticism.
reasons.penalty: Repeat hostile behavior after two documented warnings favors a private warning with a record, while mutual provocation, incomplete context, and the pending-senior note weigh against suspension.
reasons.harassment_severity: A single exclusionary personal attack with prior warnings but mitigating mutual escalation lands around moderate, short of serious threats or slurs.
